title: Koofe Me Yeh Muslim Par Kya Aalame ghurbat Hai
body:
Koofe Me Yeh Muslim Par Kya Aalame ghurbat Hai
karbal Ke Shaheedoun Ki Aaghaz-e-shahadat Hai
1. Kaisa Yeh Sitam Toota Pardes Me Muslim Par
yawar Hai Na Monis Hai Kaisi Yeh Musibat Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Afsos Musafer Par Woh Zulm-o-sitam Dhaye
zakhmi Haai Badan Sara Yeh Kaisi Adawat Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sar Kaat Ke Phainka Hai Kothay Se Tan-e-muslim
matam Karo Sar Peeto Yeh Waqt-e-qayamat Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Muslim Ki Yateema Ko Pehnate Hain Sheh Gouhar
par Sheh Ki Nigahou'n Me Beti Ki Bhi Ghurbat Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Karbal Me Mila Pursa Yun Sheh Ka Sakina Ko
durray Hain Tamache Hain Har Gaam Aziyat Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Darwaze Pe Le Jaakar Latkaya Sar-e-muslim
mustaq Karo Matam Muslim Ki Shahadat Hai
